name: al
displayName: AL Language extension for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
description: Development tools for Dynamics 365 Business Central

viewsWelcome.contents:
You can [open a folder containing an AL project](command:vscode.openFolder), or create a new AL project.
[Create AL Project](command:al.go)

Learn more about Dynamics 365 Business Central development [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/training/paths/development-get-started-business-central?wt.mc_id=d365bc_inproduct_alextension).

languageModelTools.name: al_build
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Builds the current AL project with a single command. The AL compiler checks for errors and warnings, ensuring your code is correct and up to date, and then generates a deployable .app file. Agents should use this tool to quickly validate and package AL projects, streamlining the development workflow and reducing manual steps.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Build the current AL project.

languageModelTools.name: al_downloadsymbols
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Automatically downloads all dependent symbols required by the current AL project. This ensures your project has access to the latest symbols from referenced apps and the platform, enabling accurate IntelliSense, validation, and builds. Agents should use this tool to keep dependencies up to date and avoid missing symbol errors during development. System symbols are downloaded automatically if platform and application exist in the app.json file.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Download Symbols for the current AL project.

languageModelTools.name: al_getpackagedependencies
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Automatically retrieves all dependent apps required by the current AL project or a specified package. This ensures your project has access to the latest symbols from referenced apps and the platform, enabling accurate IntelliSense, validation, and builds. Agents should use this tool to keep dependencies up to date and avoid missing symbol errors during development.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get Package Dependencies for an AL package.

packageName.description: Package Name to return dependencies for - example 'MyGreatApp'. If not provided, dependencies for the current project will be returned.

languageModelTools.name: al_downloadsource
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Invokes the extension command to download AL source code for the workspace from the Business Central environment set in your launch.json, returning success or failure.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Download source code for the current AL project (wrapper around AL: Download Source).

languageModelTools.name: al_clearcredentialscache
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Clears cached authentication credentials via the AL extension command.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Clear cached authentication credentials (wrapper around AL: Clear credentials cache).

languageModelTools.name: al_insertevent
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Inserts an event subscriber or publisher via the AL extension command.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Insert an AL event (wrapper around AL: Find Event / Insert Event).

languageModelTools.name: al_clearprofilecodelenses
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Clears profile code lenses in the current AL workspace.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Clear profile code lenses (wrapper around AL: Clear Profile Code Lenses).

languageModelTools.name: al_initalizesnapshotdebugging
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Initializes a snapshot debugging session via the AL extension command.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Initialize a snapshot debugging session (wrapper around AL: Initialize snapshot debugging).

languageModelTools.name: al_finishsnapshotdebugging
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Finishes an active snapshot debugging session via the AL extension command.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Finish the current snapshot debugging session (wrapper around AL: Finish snapshot debugging).

languageModelTools.name: al_go
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Executes the AL: Go! command to initialize an AL project. This command is used to start a new AL project.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run the AL: Go! command (initialize a project).

languageModelTools.name: al_newproject
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Creates a new AL project using the AL: New Project command.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a new AL project.

languageModelTools.name: al_incrementalpublish
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Performs a rapid application publish with debugging. By enabling delta compilation, RAD allows developers to focus on changes made to application objects, reducing build and publish times for large projects. (wrapper around AL: Rapid Application Publish with debugging).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Incrementally publish the current AL project with debugging enabled.

languageModelTools.name: al_debugWithoutpublish
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Starts a debug session without publishing (wrapper around AL: Debug without publishing).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Start a debug session without publishing the extension.

languageModelTools.name: al_buildall
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Builds all AL projects in the workspace including the complete dependency tree. This command builds not just the active project but all dependent projects as well, ensuring the entire solution is compiled together. Use this when you need to build the complete workspace or when working with multi-project solutions. The tool automatically attempts to download required Business Central system symbols before building. Agents should use this for comprehensive workspace builds that include all dependencies.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Build all AL projects in the workspace including dependencies. Use this to build the entire solution with its full dependency tree.

languageModelTools.name: al_generatecpuprofilefile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Generates a CPU profile file for performance analysis.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Generate a CPU profile file (wrapper around AL: Generate profile file).

languageModelTools.name: al_generatemanifest
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Generates a manifest file for the current AL project.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Generate a manifest file (wrapper around AL: Generate manifest).

languageModelTools.name: al_generatepermissionsetforextensionobjects
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Generates a permission set AL object for current extension objects.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Generate a permission set AL object containing current extension objects (wrapper around AL: Generate permission set as AL object).

languageModelTools.name: al_generatepermissionsetforextensionobjectsasxml
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Generates a permission set XML file for current extension objects.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Generate a permission set XML file containing current extension objects (wrapper around AL: Generate permission set as XML).

languageModelTools.name: al_openeventrecorder
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Opens the AL Event Recorder UI (wrapper around AL: Open Event Recorder).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open the AL Event Recorder interface to capture runtime events.

languageModelTools.name: al_openPageDesigner
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Opens the AL Page Designer (wrapper around AL: Open Page Designer).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open the AL Page Designer interface for the current page context.

languageModelTools.name: al_package
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Packages the AL project (wrapper around AL: Package).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create an app package for the current AL project.

languageModelTools.name: al_publish
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Publishes the built AL package to the target environment (wrapper around AL: Publish).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Publish the AL package to the configured Business Central environment.

languageModelTools.name: al_publishwithoutdebug
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Publishes the AL package without starting a debug session (wrapper around AL: Publish without debugging).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Publish the AL package without initiating a debug session.

languageModelTools.name: al_publishexistingextension
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Publishes an already packaged existing extension and starts debugging (wrapper around AL: Publish Existing Extension).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Publish an existing packaged AL extension to the target environment with debugging.

languageModelTools.name: al_viewsnapshots
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inputs: none. Outputs: { success: boolean, error?: string }. Opens the snapshots view (wrapper around AL: Snapshots).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open the AL snapshots interface.

al.editorServicesPath.description: Path to Editor Services host executable.

al.useLegacyRuntime.description: Use the .NET Framework runtime for hosting the language service instead of the .NET 5+ runtime. Enabling this option might result in a reduced level of performance.
al.useLegacyRuntime.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: From extension version 11.0, this option no longer has any effect.

enumDescriptions: Captures every log message; this will generate a lot of data.
Captures normal, warning, and error messages.
Captures warning and error messages.
Captures only error messages.
al.editorServicesLogLevel.description: Sets the logging verbosity level for the AL Language Editor Services host executable. Possible values are 'Verbose', 'Normal', 'Warning', and 'Error'

al.packageCachePath.description: Sets the directory paths where reference symbol packages are located. If more than one path is specified, downloaded symbols will be placed into the first path.

al.snapshotOutputPath.description: Sets the directory path where snapshot files are saved.

al.statementLensMin.description: Defines the lower limit for time spent on statement execution, which will be shown when opening a code file through the AL profiler.

al.areProfileLensesSupported.description: Specifies whether statement lenses are supported for the profiler.

al.incognito.description: Specifies whether to open the browser in Incognito/InPrivate mode when launching the application from Visual Studio Code. This option will take effect only if the 'al.browser' option is set to a non-default value.

al.browser.description: Specifies the browser in which to open the Business Central client when launching the application from Visual Studio Code

al.enableCodeAnalysis.description: Specifies whether the code analysis should be performed for all source files in the opened folder

al.backgroundCodeAnalysis.description: Specifies whether the code analysis should be performed in the background and the scope of the analysis. The 'false' value is equivalent to 'None' and the 'true' value is equivalent to 'File' for backwards compatibility.

al.enableExternalRulesets.description: Allows the use of urls as the location of project rulesets or included rulesets.

al.outputAnalyzerStatistics.description: Specifies whether code analyzer performance statistics will be output when running a build.

al.incrementalBuild.description: Specifies whether the compiler should reuse the existing background compilation for creating the package.

enumDescriptions: CodeCop is an analyzer that enforces the official AL coding guidelines.
AppSourceCop is an analyzer that enforces rules that must be respected by extensions meant to be published to Microsoft AppSource.
PerTenantExtensionCop is an analyzer that enforces rules that must be respected by extensions meant to be installed for individual tenants.
UICop is an analyzer that enforces rules that must be respected by extensions meant to customize the web client.

al.codeAnalyzers.description: Sets the list of paths to code analyzers to use for performing code analysis.

al.ruleSetPath.description: Sets the path to the file containing the customized rules to use when running code analysis. The path can be a filesystem path or a fully qualified remote url.

al.namespaceTemplate.description: Specifies the default namespace template to be used when creating new files or adding namespaces via code actions.

al.enableCodeActions.description: Specifies whether the code actions should be enabled for all source files in the current project.

al.enableScriptIntelliSense.description: Specifies whether IntelliSense should be enabled for control addin script files. Set to false if it interferes with advanced JavaScript or TypeScript configurations.

al.assemblyProbingPaths.description: Sets the list of directory paths where the compiler should search for referenced .NET assemblies.

al.snapshotDebuggingPath.description: Sets the directory path where the snapshot debugger sources are located.

generateReportLayout.description: Controls whether the compiler will generate Report Layout files when building the package.

parallel.description: Specifies whether the compiler should use multiple threads when building the project.

maxDegreeOfParallelism.description: Specifies the maximum number of concurrent tasks the compiler should use when compiling the project.

delayAfterLastDocumentChange.description: Specifies the number of milliseconds to wait after the last buffer changes before getting document diagnostics. After changing the value of this option, you must restart Visual Studio Code for it to take effect.

delayAfterLastProjectChange.description: Specifies the number of milliseconds to wait after the last buffer changes before getting complete diagnostics. After changing the value of this option, you must restart Visual Studio Code for it to take effect.

continueBuildOnError.description: Specifies if build should continue even if errors are found. The default and recommended value from a performance point of view is "false". Set the value to true to continue building the project, even if errors are found. It requires "al.incrementalBuild" to be false.

outFolder.description: Specifies the folder where the compiler should place the resulting .app file. If not specified, the compiler will place the resulting .app file in the project folder.

enumDescriptions: Show on every startup.
Show if there is updated news.
Never show the AL Developer Home.
al.showHomeAtStartup.description: Specifies whether the AL Developer Home is shown at startup

enumDescriptions: Show on every startup.
Show it only on first launch.
Never show the AL Developer Home.
al.showExplorerAtStartup.description: Specifies whether the AL Explorer is shown at startup

al.snapshotDebuggerLinesHitDecoration.description: Specifies the decoration values for a line that is hit by the snapshot debugger.

gutterColor.description: Defines the gutter indicator color to use for showing the lines hit by the snapshot debugger. Accepts valid color names, hex codes, and rgba() values.

al.appLocalFolderPaths.description: Specifies a list of local app repositories and their corresponding directory paths. This setting helps in organizing and managing multiple AL repositories by defining where each repository is stored on the local machine.

localFolderPath.description: The local directory path where the app is located.

al.profilerColors.description: Specifies the colors used to define the application types in the profiler output. Accepts valid color names, hex codes, and rgba() values

systemApplication.description: The color used for methods defined in the System Application.

baseApplication.description: The color used for methods defined in the Base Application.

extension.description: The color used for methods defined by other apps.

system.description: The color used for methods defined in the built-in system application.

color.description: The color of the application in the profiler file.

al.algoSuggestedFolder.description: Sets the suggested folder when using AL:Go! command.

al.inlayhints.parameterNames.enabled.description: Enable/disable inlay hints for parameter names.

al.inlayhints.functionReturnTypes.enable.description: Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit return types on function signatures.

al.semanticFolding.enabled.description: Enable/disable folding ranges given from the AL extension. Reload Visual Studio Code after changing this setting.

al.extendGoToSymbolInWorkspace.enabled.description: Enable/disable a new implementation of symbol search.

al.extendGoToSymbolInWorkspace.ResultLim.description: Sets the maximum number of symbol search.

al.useInteractiveLogin.description: Specifies whether to use interactive login or device code login for Microsoft Entra ID authentication.

al.entraIdAuthentication.description: Configuration setting overrides for Microsoft Entra ID authentication.

endpoint.description: Sets the authentication endpoint for Microsoft Entra ID.

clientId.description: Sets the client ID for Microsoft Entra ID authentication. This is used to identify the application making the authentication request.

redirectionUri.description: Sets the redirection URI for Microsoft Entra ID authentication.

scope.description: Sets the scope for Microsoft Entra ID authentication.
